newsitem.title: GERMANY: EUROGAS FORMS 15 MILLION POLISH VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: EUROGAS FORMS 15 MILLION POLISH VENTURE.

text.p: German utility Eurogas Inc said on Monday its Polish subsidiary was forming a 15 million joint-venture with Polish Oil and Gas Company (POGC) to explore for oil and natural gas in southern Poland.
Eurogas said its Polish unit Pol-Tex Methane Limited has entered into a letter of intent with POGC to form the venture.
The venture will explore for oil and natural gas in up to 21 exploration blocks which encompass over 7.5 million acres in the Carpathian Foredeep and Flysch Carpathian areas of southern Poland.
Eurogas said the deal provides for Eurogas to enter into exclusive talks to select and implement an exploration programme with a minimum expenditure of 15 million over the next three years.
Eurogas shares were suspended from trade on Monday ahead of the announcement.
Eurogas already controls major coalbed methane gas concessions in the Upper Silesian Coal basin in Poland.

At the end of March Eurogas Inc said that Pol-Tex Methane had signed an agreement with Texaco Slask Sp. z.o.o., a Polish affiliate of Texaco Inc , for Texaco to acquire the right to appraise and develop Eurogas's Pol-Tex methane gas concession 134-93.
